failure_mode_overrides.detection: Window watchdog (TSC-SM04)
failure_mode_overrides.mitigation: Watchdog timer resets to safe state (cut power to motor brake valve); window = 50 ms

failure_mode_overrides.detection: Assertion on state variable; control flow monitor
failure_mode_overrides.mitigation: FSM design reviewed; all transitions verified in unit test; assertion coverage = 95%

failure_mode_overrides.detection: Range check on denominator before division
failure_mode_overrides.mitigation: Assert wheel_slip ≠ 0 before denominator calculation; boundary test with slip = 0.001

failure_mode_overrides.detection: NaN / infinity detection (isnan() check); watchdog on output range
failure_mode_overrides.mitigation: Filter output checked for NaN at exit; any NaN cuts motor power; test with sqrt(-1) injection

failure_mode_overrides.detection: Stack partitioning (MPU) + guard page; watchdog on CPU stall
failure_mode_overrides.mitigation: Separate stack partition per task; guard page at stack limit; stack depth analysis < 80% utilization

failure_mode_overrides.detection: CRC check on EEPROM config block (TSC-SM07)
failure_mode_overrides.mitigation: Config block CRC verified at startup; any mismatch loads default calibration; test with bit flip injection

failure_mode_overrides.detection: Watchdog cycle counter; periodic heartbeat signal
failure_mode_overrides.mitigation: Each watchdog cycle increments counter; counter polled by monitor; missed cycle detected in < 100 ms

failure_mode_overrides.detection: Mutex protection on watchdog register access
failure_mode_overrides.mitigation: Critical section around watchdog reset; mutual exclusion enforced by OS; race condition test with concurrent tasks

failure_mode_overrides.detection: Timeout on mutex acquire; deadlock detection monitor
failure_mode_overrides.mitigation: Mutex timeout = 10 ms; if timeout, exception handler invokes watchdog reset; lock ordering policy enforced in code review

failure_mode_overrides.detection: Heap profiling; memory high-water mark monitor
failure_mode_overrides.mitigation: No dynamic allocation in watchdog service (fixed memory); heap test run for 100 hours; no growth observed

failure_mode_overrides.detection: CAN message heartbeat timeout in downstream receiver
failure_mode_overrides.mitigation: CAN transmit scheduled every 10 ms; downstream monitor timeout = 30 ms; missed TX detected by receiver

failure_mode_overrides.detection: E2E protection (CRC + sequence counter) on CAN frame; TSC-SM13
failure_mode_overrides.mitigation: CAN TX register guarded by mutex; each frame has sequence counter; receiver detects out-of-order or duplicate via E2E

failure_mode_overrides.detection: Readback + compare on PWM control register
failure_mode_overrides.mitigation: After each PWM duty cycle write, read register and verify match; mismatch triggers error handler and safe state

failure_mode_overrides.detection: ISR latency instrumentation; event queue overflow counter
failure_mode_overrides.mitigation: PWM ISR priority = high; latency measurement < 10% of PWM period; event queue size = 10 (overflow rare)

failure_mode_overrides.detection: Timeout counter on PWM busy-wait loop
failure_mode_overrides.mitigation: Timeout = 2× worst-case PWM latency per datasheet; if timeout, error handler invokes safe state

failure_mode_overrides.detection: DMA buffer watermark monitor; DMA error interrupt
failure_mode_overrides.mitigation: DMA buffer pre-allocated; watermark flag if < 20 bytes available; interrupt driven to refill before underrun

failure_mode_overrides.detection: Multi-sample confirmation (fault must persist for 3 consecutive samples)
failure_mode_overrides.mitigation: DTC threshold = sensor nominal ± 10%; multi-sample counter = 3; noise filtered before comparison

failure_mode_overrides.detection: Self-test (built-in test) on sensor output; dual-threshold comparison
failure_mode_overrides.mitigation: Sensor self-test every 100 ms; dual threshold (static + dynamic); fault detected within 500 ms

failure_mode_overrides.detection: DTC priority matrix documented; review of DTC order
failure_mode_overrides.mitigation: DTC priority: sensor fault > communication fault > self-test fault; matrix reviewed by diagnostics engineer

failure_mode_overrides.detection: CRC on diagnostic log block (TSC-SM07); log fullness counter
failure_mode_overrides.mitigation: DTC history = 100 entries max; oldest entry rotated out on overflow; CRC verified on each read
